trailhead.label: Chiusaforte town hall, the board’s start

cautions: Steep steps and a steep, fast descent from the falls.
Brambles on the path near the village.
The Alpe Adria cycle path at the end: keep your dog close to the edge, bikes are fast.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
